entities.name: Fang Druids
entities.description: Band-culture of great druidic apes (mostly gorillas) and humans hidden in Muraganda's jungles, attuned to the plane's heartbeat.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: Plane whose crater jungles the Fang Druids inhabit.

entities.name: Saurid Autocracy
entities.description: Society with a species hierarchy, contrasted with the Fang Druids.

relations.note: Live hidden in its dense jungles.
relations.quote: live hidden among the dense jungles of Muraganda
